Dangerous Goods

Umverpackungskennzeichnung

A regulatory marking required on an overpack containing dangerous goods, to indicate that multiple packages are combined for transport (IATA, IMDG, ADR).

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Umverpackungskennzeichnung?

In this glossary, Umverpackungskennzeichnung refers to: A regulatory marking required on an overpack containing dangerous goods, to indicate that multiple packages are combined for transport (IATA, IMDG, ADR).

How is Umverpackungskennzeichnung used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Werden zwei oder mehr Gefahrgutverpackungen in einer Umverpackung zusammengefasst, muss gemäß IATA- und IMDG-Vorschriften die Kennzeichnung 'Overpack' deutlich sichtbar sein."

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A regulatory marking required on an overpack containing dangerous goods, to indicate that multiple packages are combined for transport (IATA, IMDG, ADR).

Operational example

When two or more packages of dangerous goods are combined in an overpack, 'Overpack' marking must be clearly visible as per IATA and IMDG regulations.

Localized term

Umverpackungskennzeichnung

Localized example

Werden zwei oder mehr Gefahrgutverpackungen in einer Umverpackung zusammengefasst, muss gemäß IATA- und IMDG-Vorschriften die Kennzeichnung 'Overpack' deutlich sichtbar sein.
